rnaseq_results.title: nf-core/rnaseq Results
rnaseq_results.description: Output of an nf-core/rnaseq run, which provides the gene count matrix

input.title: Sample Metadata
input.description: CSV or TSV table with a 'sample' column naming each sample as in the count matrix, and a column for each variable used in the contrasts
input.errorMessage: Must be an uncompressed CSV or TSV table (.csv or .tsv)

shiny_app_settings.title: Build Shiny App
shiny_app_settings.description: Trigger generation of files you can quickly use to spin up a shiny app locally. Note: the generated app is not deployed to Cirro. To use it you need to download the Shiny app files and have an appropriate local R environment to run it.

shinyngs_build_app.title: Enabled
shinyngs_build_app.description: Should a Shiny app be built?

schema.title: Contrasts
schema.description: One row per comparison between two groups of samples, defined by the values of a column in the Sample Metadata table.

id.title: Contrast ID
id.description: Name used for this contrast's output files
id.errorMessage: Contrast IDs can only contain letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores

variable.title: Variable Column
variable.description: Sample Metadata column whose values define the groups

reference.title: Reference Value
reference.description: Value in the variable column for the reference group

target.title: Target Value
target.description: Value in the variable column for the target group

blocking.title: Blocking Columns
blocking.description: Optional Sample Metadata columns to model alongside the variable, separated by semicolons (e.g. replicate;batch)
